meta.notes: v0.1 ships a data-driven original roster with distinct personalities. Hidden legends stay hidden until intel or Seek Legend. Mid-step toward the 500 cap.

playerTemplate.title: Wanderer
playerTemplate.bio: A civilian who did not get out before the airlift windows closed.

backgrounds.name: Bush Scout
backgrounds.blurb: Knows drainages, caches, and when to stay off a ridgeline.

backgrounds.name: Town Organizer
backgrounds.blurb: Can turn a meeting hall into a ration desk.

backgrounds.name: Range Fighter
backgrounds.blurb: Hunting seasons were not sport. They were practice.

backgrounds.name: Hall Speaker
backgrounds.blurb: People listen when the lights are out and the list is short.

aggressive.label: Aggressive
aggressive.blurb: Seeks contact. Drills and marches before talking.

cautious.label: Cautious
cautious.blurb: Builds walls and waits for a sure opening.

diplomat.label: Diplomat
diplomat.blurb: Treaties first. Will fight if boxed in.

merchant.label: Merchant
merchant.blurb: Gold and grain are a kind of ammunition.

loyalist.label: Loyalist
loyalist.blurb: Holds the line for whoever currently feeds the town.

ambitious.label: Ambitious
ambitious.blurb: Wants a bigger chair. May listen to a better offer.

officers.name: Daren Voss
officers.title: Occupation Colonel
officers.bio: Spearhead of the Bowl landing. Treats delay as insubordination.

officers.name: Petra Rusk
officers.title: Slope Major
officers.bio: Holds the oil like a vault. Will not gamble the pipeline on a raid.

officers.name: Cal Nenko
officers.title: Peninsula Sergeant
officers.bio: Local conscript who stayed when the officers flew. Follows the last order given.

officers.name: Harlan Pike
officers.title: Interior Captain
officers.bio: Wants to punch south before the occupiers finish digging in.

officers.name: Yuna Iktuk
officers.title: River Guide
officers.bio: Keeps families fed and unlisted. Dislikes speeches and uniforms.

officers.name: Rhee Solano
officers.title: Harbor Captain
officers.bio: Still talks like a capital exists. Collects favors the way others collect rifles.

officers.name: Maris Quell
officers.title: Ferry Factor
officers.bio: If it floats, she can price it. Occupation scrip, fish, and silence.

officers.name: Mira Solen
officers.title: Night Pilot
officers.bio: Flies dead-reckoning corridors. Sells what she sees to whoever pays in fuel.

officers.name: Tobias Wren
officers.title: Signals Hand
officers.bio: Keeps a civil tongue on an uncivil radio net. Prefers bargains to ambushes.

officers.name: Oleg Brant
officers.title: Island Commander
officers.bio: Wants Kodiak to outrank the Bowl. A dangerous ally for anyone but himself.

officers.name: Lena Ostrov
officers.title: Harbor Guns
officers.bio: Will not leave the island batteries. The sea, she says, is already a wall.

officers.name: Eli Hart
officers.title: Volunteer
officers.bio: School-shop teacher with a rifle and a list of names still in town.

officers.name: Sable Quinn
officers.title: Road Agent
officers.bio: Runs the Sterling Highway at night. Will sign on if the pay and the legend match.

officers.name: Ilya Karr
officers.title: Slope Ghost
officers.bio: Old trapline hand. Some maps still have his lines. He does not answer radios.

officers.name: Anat Kade
officers.title: Depot Major
officers.bio: Turns captured warehouses into a calendar. Hates wasted fuel more than snipers.

officers.name: Irik Morrow
officers.title: Airlift Officer
officers.bio: Wants the next star. Treats the Bowl runway as his private ladder.

officers.name: Vera Tselin
officers.title: Political Officer
officers.bio: Files on everyone. Smiles when a town goes quiet after a pamphlet drop.

officers.name: Joren Havel
officers.title: Pipeline Guard
officers.bio: Walks the pipe in whiteouts. Will not leave a valve uncounted.

officers.name: Min Choi
officers.title: Ice Road Captain
officers.bio: Moves convoys only when the ice reads honest. Delay is a tool.

officers.name: Pavel Dmitr
officers.title: Forward Observer
officers.bio: Calls fire on ridgelines the maps still mark as empty.

officers.name: Nadja Sere
officers.title: Occupation Clerk
officers.bio: Writes passes that keep villages working. Collects names for later.

officers.name: Karel Rosh
officers.title: Bering Liaison
officers.bio: Talks across the strait as if ice were a conference table. Nearby pressure, not a second theater.

officers.name: Shin Kuro
officers.title: Destroyer Skipper
officers.bio: Wants a clean shot at the Bowl sea-lane. Fuel is the only argument he hears.

officers.name: Edda Vale
officers.title: Island Quartermaster
officers.bio: Prices shell and salt fish the same way. Will not starve the batteries.

officers.name: Kast Rime
officers.title: Aleutian Scout
officers.bio: Comes in from fog with island names nobody asked for. Leaves the same night.

officers.name: Tomas Orlov
officers.title: Prize Officer
officers.bio: Wants captured hulls and a chair that outranks Brant. Dangerous in a harbor.

officers.name: Ruth Mack
officers.title: Rail Foreman
officers.bio: Keeps the spur moving in forty below. Trusts Pike until the coal runs out.

officers.name: Jace Talon
officers.title: Bush Pilot
officers.bio: Lands on rivers like they owe him. Wants a fight south before the occupiers pave it.

officers.name: Anana Kipp
officers.title: Cache Keeper
officers.bio: Knows which spruce hides a winter box. Will not open them for speeches.

officers.name: Cal Brody
officers.title: Yukon Ferryman
officers.bio: Moves people and sacks, not ideology. The river still charges in daylight.

officers.name: Nora Hess
officers.title: Clinic Lead
officers.bio: Talks town councils down from stupid raids. Counts frostbite like a ledger.

officers.name: Sam Wicks
officers.title: Trapline Judge
officers.bio: Settles disputes on the line and vanishes. Uniforms make him leave early.

officers.name: Owen Bell
officers.title: Assembly Clerk
officers.bio: Still stamps papers as if a capital answers. Sometimes it almost does.

officers.name: Hana Park
officers.title: Cannery Boss
officers.bio: Fish and tin keep Juneau from kneeling. She prices both without blinking.

officers.name: Tess Lyle
officers.title: Passage Pilot
officers.bio: Knows which narrows hide a gunboat. Will not run a fog she cannot name.

officers.name: Gideon Reed
officers.title: Harbor Lawyer
officers.bio: Turns seizures into paperwork. Keeps a second set of berth assignments.

officers.name: Mara Skye
officers.title: Fish Union
officers.bio: Crews follow her before they follow flags. Hates anyone who burns nets.

officers.name: Inga Yarrow
officers.title: Bering Factor
officers.bio: Trades across ice that used to be a border. Compact lost the desk when the Pact took the strait.

officers.name: Ivo Fen
officers.title: Night Radio
officers.bio: Sits a dead frequency until someone blinks. Sells the blink in pieces.

officers.name: Kira Ash
officers.title: Cache Runner
officers.bio: Moves sealed crates that do not rattle. Does not ask what they are.

officers.name: Ben Doll
officers.title: Cipher Hand
officers.bio: One-time pads on a typewriter. Prefers a handshake on a cold dock.

officers.name: Pia York
officers.title: Weather Net
officers.bio: Reads storms on shortwave and a CRT map. Will not launch a boat into a lie.

officers.name: Drew Cole
officers.title: River Teacher
officers.bio: Kept the school stove lit. Will follow a banner that feeds the kids first.

officers.name: Vesper Nash
officers.title: Scrip Broker
officers.bio: Buys silence and stove oil. A hire if you can outbid the next rumor.

officers.name: Micah Holt
officers.title: Ice Fisherman
officers.bio: Cuts holes and waits. Will not march until the ice says so.

officers.name: Lark Raine
officers.title: Mail Pilot
officers.bio: Wants a route that outlives the war. Will sign if you have fuel and a story.

officers.name: Wei Zhao
officers.title: Workshop Hand
officers.bio: Fixes captured Jeeps and pickups under occupation lights. Keeps a second set of wrenches.

officers.name: Orla Faye
officers.title: Clinic Runner
officers.bio: Talks checkpoints into letting a stretcher through. Tired of both uniforms.

officers.name: Tom Bess
officers.title: Dock Stevedore
officers.bio: Throws crates and punches in the same motion. Banner tried to conscript him twice.

officers.name: Uly Morn
officers.title: Tundra Walker
officers.bio: Shares Karr's country but answers a knock. Sometimes. Not a legend, just spare.

officers.name: Sera Gant
officers.title: Border Guide
officers.bio: Walks the south passes toward Canadian rumor. Sells maps with two truths.

officers.name: Hal Keene
officers.title: Salvage Diver
officers.bio: Pulls analog radios out of hulks. Wants a crew that pays in parts, not medals.

officers.name: Ellen Haro
officers.title: Relay Clerk
officers.bio: Stamps south-pass paper as if a border still means something. Will talk before she will march.

officers.name: Bo Tagg
officers.title: Claim Judge
officers.bio: Holds the mine road and waits. Occupier scrip does not buy a claim in his book.

officers.name: Nils Silo
officers.title: Yukon Radio Ghost
officers.bio: Keeps a dead microwave spur alive with analog parts. Occupiers hear static; the Relay hears a name.

officers.name: Cal Marsh
officers.title: Ranch Marshal
officers.bio: Rides the western foothills with militia horse scouts and a 1986 Winchester. Will not take a foreign color.

officers.name: Irina Brack
officers.title: Armor NCO
officers.bio: Runs captured M113s like they still have a depot. Speaks in ranges and fuel hours.

officers.name: Tess Lumen
officers.title: Shortwave Ace
officers.bio: Turns a ham set and a CRT into a weather and rumor net. People answer her callsigns.

officers.name: Jonah Stave
officers.title: Timber Boss
officers.bio: Owns the mill road and the men who still cut in winter. Will not spend a levy on a rumor.

officers.name: Mira Gora
officers.title: Ice Pilot
officers.bio: Flies analog instruments into Slope weather. Writes off a runway as a suggestion.

officers.name: Lev Petro
officers.title: Fuel Clerk
officers.bio: Counts drums like they are votes. Occupation gold spends; his ledger does not.

officers.name: Oksana Tarn
officers.title: Sentry Chief
officers.bio: Stacks sandbags on the Nome spit and waits for a jeep that is not hers.

officers.name: Dmitri Volk
officers.title: Depot Guard
officers.bio: Sleeps next to the ammo hut. Banner tried to poach him and left a tooth.

officers.name: Katya Mira
officers.title: Signals NCO
officers.bio: Listens to civilian traffic and files it as weather. Sometimes it is.

officers.name: Pavel Boris
officers.title: Convoy Lead
officers.bio: Will not roll a column until the gold road is glassed twice.

officers.name: Ilya Nazar
officers.title: Slope Driver
officers.bio: Knows every drum cache between Prudhoe rumor and the Brooks. Talks to the truck.

officers.name: Nina Sova
officers.title: Clinic Officer
officers.bio: Patches occupier and local with the same kit. Keeps a second list of names.

officers.name: Anton Krol
officers.title: Dock Watch
officers.bio: Counts hulls in the dark. Shoots first at a running light that does not answer.

officers.name: Vera Duna
officers.title: Ration Desk
officers.bio: Turns occupation scrip into stove oil. Everybody owes her a week.

officers.name: Gleb Rusin
officers.title: Wire Team
officers.bio: Taps analog lines on the south pass. Sells silence in both directions.

officers.name: Kara Helm
officers.title: Beachmaster
officers.bio: Puts men on a wet gravel beach and expects them to stay. They usually do.

officers.name: Ned Croft
officers.title: Hull Boss
officers.bio: Keeps relic patrol boats floating with 1980s parts and threats.

officers.name: Sam Vell
officers.title: Levy Clerk
officers.bio: Writes names on a clipboard as if a navy still exists. Some of them answer.

officers.name: Dara Rook
officers.title: Night Coxswain
officers.bio: Wants a channel that outlives the landing. Will trade charts for fuel.

officers.name: Otto Brine
officers.title: Net Cutter
officers.bio: Cuts crab gear that fouls a screw. Prefers the work to the speech.

officers.name: Lina Gale
officers.title: Weather Deck
officers.bio: Will not launch into a lie. Reads storms off a CRT and a wet barometer.

officers.name: Ruth Aspen
officers.title: Mill Foreman
officers.bio: Keeps the mill whistle honest. A banner that feeds her crew can have a levy.

officers.name: Cal Flint
officers.title: Road Boss
officers.bio: Jeeps, graders, and a short temper. The gold road is his argument.

officers.name: Eden Moss
officers.title: Cache Keeper
officers.bio: Hides drums off the Whitehorse spur. Sells them to whoever still uses cash.

officers.name: Tom Birch
officers.title: Trapline Judge
officers.bio: Walks a line that predates both armies. Will not radio a location twice.

officers.name: Nia Sable
officers.title: School Stove
officers.bio: Kept the hall lit. Talks a checkpoint into letting a crate of flour through.

officers.name: Wes Ridge
officers.title: Ridge Watch
officers.bio: Glasses the mine road from a timber stand. Occupier scrip does not buy a pass.

officers.name: Peg Coal
officers.title: Shop Hand
officers.bio: Fixes Jeep carburetors under a drop light. Keeps a second set of plugs.

officers.name: Ivy Thorn
officers.title: Rumor Desk
officers.bio: Types one-time pads on a borrowed Selectric. Prefers a handshake in the mill lot.

officers.name: Mara Dock
officers.title: Harbor Speaker
officers.bio: Turns a meeting hall into a ration desk. Compact paper still means something to her.

officers.name: Jon Kelp
officers.title: Troller Skipper
officers.bio: Runs a wet deck and a CB. Will not land a levy in a storm for anyone's map.

officers.name: Ada Pearl
officers.title: Cannery Clerk
officers.bio: Counts cans like they are gold. Occupation markets still knock; she still says no.

officers.name: Ben Spray
officers.title: Pier Guard
officers.bio: Throws a line and a punch in the same motion. Banner tried the dock twice.

officers.name: Cora Mist
officers.title: Pass Guide
officers.bio: Walks the south passes toward Canadian rumor. Sells maps with two truths.

officers.name: Owen Hale
officers.title: Hall Trustee
officers.bio: Keeps Compact minutes as if a capital still exists. It does, on paper, here.

officers.name: Lila Foss
officers.title: Radio Relay
officers.bio: Forwards Compact traffic on analog sets. Will not encrypt a lie.

officers.name: Soren Frost
officers.title: Ice Net
officers.bio: Reads storms and ice like a ledger. Will not launch a boat into a rumor.

officers.name: Kira Amber
officers.title: Hall Singer
officers.bio: People listen when the lights are out and the list is short. She keeps the list.

officers.name: Ned Quartz
officers.title: Claim Walker
officers.bio: Walks the spit at odd hours. Aurora pays him in stove oil and silence.

officers.name: Pia Willow
officers.title: Clinic Lead
officers.bio: Talks checkpoints into letting a stretcher through. Tired of both uniforms.

officers.name: Rex Cinder
officers.title: Shop Foreman
officers.bio: Keeps captured Jeeps running under aurora lights. A second set of wrenches, always.

officers.name: Uma Nook
officers.title: Cache Runner
officers.bio: Crosses ice with a pack and a story. Sells the story cheaper than the pack.

officers.name: Hana Ice
officers.title: Strait Watch
officers.bio: Glasses the ice for hulls that do not belong. Pact paper is thin; her watch is not.

officers.name: Bo Drift
officers.title: Skiff Hand
officers.bio: Rows a skiff like the strait still has a civilian schedule. It does not.

officers.name: Yna Salt
officers.title: Pact Clerk
officers.bio: Stamps ice-pact paper as if a border still means something. Will talk before she will row.

officers.name: Cal Wire
officers.title: Spur Tech
officers.bio: Keeps a microwave spur coughing on analog parts. Haro stamps; he solders.

officers.name: Meg Lane
officers.title: South Pass
officers.bio: Walks the road toward rumor of a still-open customs hut. Prefers stamps to rifles.

officers.name: Gus Ford
officers.title: Grader Hand
officers.bio: Keeps the gold road from eating a Jeep. Will not grade at night for anyone.

officers.name: Ned Claim
officers.title: Mine Watch
officers.bio: Holds a claim stake like a flag. Occupier scrip does not buy a shovel here.

officers.name: Rita Pan
officers.title: Assay Clerk
officers.bio: Weighs dust and rumors with the same scale. Tagg judges; she writes the number.

officers.name: Len Shaft
officers.title: Timber Prop
officers.bio: Puts a beam in a hole and a fist on a claim jumper. Same week, sometimes.

officers.name: Nora Pell
officers.title: River Nurse
officers.bio: Kept the clinic stove lit. Will follow a banner that feeds the kids first.

officers.name: Sam Tule
officers.title: Net Mender
officers.bio: Mends nets and arguments. A hire if you can keep the hall from starving.

officers.name: Kit Low
officers.title: Bush Mechanic
officers.bio: Fixes pickups with baling wire and 1985 manuals. Wants parts, not medals.

officers.name: Aja Pell
officers.title: Hall Scribe
officers.bio: Writes the ration list twice so nobody 'loses' a line. Tired of both armies.

officers.name: Cal Brook
officers.title: River Scout
officers.bio: Knows drainages and caches. Will sign if you have fuel and a story that lasts.

officers.name: Willa Sedge
officers.title: Smokehouse
officers.bio: Smokes fish like the season still has a calendar. It does, if you feed people.

officers.name: Jon Rill
officers.title: School Stove
officers.bio: Kept the school stove lit through the airlift window. Wants a banner that does the same.

officers.name: Ned Peat
officers.title: Cache Digger
officers.bio: Digs drums in the tundra and forgets who asked. Sometimes he remembers a name.

officers.name: Tess Oak
officers.title: Foothill Guide
officers.bio: Rides the western ranch grade. Horse scouts and Jeep columns share her dust.

officers.name: Bo Hay
officers.title: Ranch Hand
officers.bio: Throws bales and punches in the same motion. Will not take a foreign color.

officers.name: Nia Lark
officers.title: Clinic Runner
officers.bio: Talks a checkpoint into a stretcher. Kenai still has a hall; she still has a list.

officers.name: Cal Spur
officers.title: Gravel Strip
officers.bio: Marks a dirt strip for analog weather and a Huey that may never come. Wants a crew.

officers.name: Meg Ash
officers.title: Mill Runner
officers.bio: Carries mill scrip and a rumor. Interior tried to conscript her twice.

officers.name: Otto Cask
officers.title: Fuel Skipper
officers.bio: Sells unmarked fuel on the spit. A hire if you can outbid the next rumor.

officers.name: Ivy Gale
officers.title: Ice Fisherman
officers.bio: Cuts holes and waits. Will not march until the ice says so.

officers.name: Rex Hull
officers.title: Dock Stevedore
officers.bio: Throws crates. Banner tried to sign him; he threw the clipboard.

officers.name: Sera Wick
officers.title: Cannery Night
officers.bio: Night shift and a second set of keys. Sells silence cheaper than fish.

officers.name: Hal Pass
officers.title: Border Guide
officers.bio: Walks the south pass toward Canadian rumor. Maps with two truths, still.

officers.name: Uma Dell
officers.title: Pier Speaker
officers.bio: Turns a pier meeting into a ration desk. Compact paper, civilian voice.

officers.name: Ned Pipe
officers.title: Workshop Hand
officers.bio: Fixes captured Jeeps under occupation lights. Keeps a second set of wrenches.

officers.name: Kira Veil
officers.title: Clinic Shadow
officers.bio: Walks occupier wards with a civilian bag. Tired of both uniforms.

officers.name: Bo Tundra
officers.title: Slope Walker
officers.bio: Shares Karr's country and answers a knock. Sometimes. Spare, not legend.

officers.name: Pia Radio
officers.title: Ham Volunteer
officers.bio: Keeps a dead spur alive on donated tubes. Wants a banner that pays in parts.

officers.name: Len Dust
officers.title: Claim Jumper
officers.bio: Walks Tagg's road with a shovel and a story. Watch will not hire him; you might.

officers.name: Ada Skiff
officers.title: Ice Rower
officers.bio: Rows the strait on analog compass and rumor. Pact tried to stamp her; she rowed.

officers.name: Mira Quay
officers.title: Wharf Clerk
officers.bio: Stamps before rifles on the Sound. Occupation civil, not a landing colonel.

officers.name: Rex Kiln
officers.title: Pier Sergeant
officers.bio: Holds the pier wire. Hates rain more than partisans.

officers.name: Nia Volta
officers.title: Haul Boss
officers.bio: Treats I-5 as a country. Parts first, flags second.

officers.name: Cal Crane
officers.title: Depot Dispatcher
officers.bio: Capitol yards and a clipboard. Keeps the grade open if the scrip is real.

officers.name: Tess Saw
officers.title: Mill Captain
officers.bio: Weekend drill that never stopped. Pine ridges and a ranch-grade jeep.

officers.name: Hank Bluff
officers.title: Pine Sergeant
officers.bio: Falls-town rifles. Distrusts ports and anyone who talks like a desk.

officers.name: June Loft
officers.title: Lodge Scout
officers.bio: Walks the ALCAN rumor south of Whitehorse. Counts trucks, not speeches.

officers.name: Roy Cimarron
officers.title: Highway Band
officers.bio: Bench raids and scrap copper. Not a licensed outlaw — just a long grade.

officers.name: Lila Pueblo
officers.title: Scrap Rider
officers.bio: Rim-town hulls and a second set of plates. Sells metal to whoever pays stove oil.

officers.name: Otis Nampa
officers.title: Lake Road
officers.bio: Lake caches and a mine-road jeep. Copper Road's quiet northern desk.

officers.name: Ed Duran
officers.title: Yard Foreman
officers.bio: Owns the wrenches and the strike vote. Cheyenne yards still answer him.

officers.name: Ruth Palis
officers.title: Shop Steward
officers.bio: Bench shops and a mimeograph. Talks first; the line stays hers.

officers.name: Vera Range
officers.title: Airlift Major
officers.bio: Front Range strip and leftover C-130 hulks. Weather is her real colonel.

officers.name: Pam Jct
officers.title: Hall Chair
officers.bio: Orchard minutes and a borrowed ham set. West-slope civic, not a garrison.

officers.name: Ty Wesco
officers.title: Ranch Clerk
officers.bio: Hole-town lists and a horse scout on the porch. Posts the week in pencil.

officers.name: Ivy Front
officers.title: Campus Dean
officers.bio: Mimeographs and CRT labs on the mile. Young labor, analog jammers, no film-unit name.

officers.name: Cal Mesa
officers.title: Canyon Guide
officers.bio: Redrock dead-drops. Idle Hour stamps the hall; he walks the wash.
